articles.summary: AI QA testing with nunu works like this: you describe a test in plain English ("complete the tutorial," "complete the signup flow and verify the confirmation email screen appears"), and an AI agent executes it on a real device by looking at the screen and interacting like a human user. No test scripts, no engine integration, no SDK required to start.
articles.title: How to Test Your Game or App with AI Agents: A Complete Guide to Automated QA

articles.summary: The same agents you know from mobile, now testing games and software on a full Windows PC.
articles.title: Meet nunu for Windows: AI Agents That Operate a Full PC
